overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the joint meeting notice was timely and sufficiently detailed, and the Board of Selectmen properly joined the executive session as a party to the pending lawsuit.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to post notice of its January 11, 2016 joint meeting with the Board of Selectmen.
allegations.key_passage: The Board posted notice of this joint meeting at least 48 hours in advance of the meeting and included a sufficiently detailed list of the anticipated topics.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board of Selectmen, which was not a party to the lawsuit, improperly participated in the Board's executive session.
allegations.key_passage: To the contrary, the Board of Selectmen is a party to the pending lawsuit and therefore had a litigation position to protect.
